doctypes.title: Product brief
doctypes.purpose: Who the plan is for, the problem it solves, what is in and out of scope, and how success is recognised.

doctypes.title: Product requirements
doctypes.purpose: What the product must do: numbered functional and non-functional requirements, each testable, with the users and journeys they serve.

doctypes.title: Technical spec
doctypes.purpose: How the product will be built in one document: approach and stack, the parts and how they fit, the state kept, the main flows, and how it is tested.

doctypes.title: Architecture
doctypes.purpose: The structure that meets the requirements: components and their boundaries, data and its ownership, the decisions taken with their alternatives, and the risks.

doctypes.title: Development plan
doctypes.purpose: The order of work to the seal: epics, their sequence and dependencies, what each delivers, and how each is known to be done.

doctypes.title: Stories
doctypes.purpose: The epics broken into stories, each with acceptance criteria a test can check.
